reply: rm is mostly a rising, saturating function of t, roughly 1−e^(−0.064·t) in shape, with almost no P-dependence. Simpler shapes (tanh, t·e^(−bt), log(1+bt)) reach about 6e-5 and the best product with P only about 4e-5, so I could not pin down its exact form within the call budget. I used all 14 calls.

def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0]*np.sqrt(P) + params[1]*np.sin(params[2]*t)*P + params[3]*np.abs(t)**params[4]*np.exp(-params[5]*t)*P**params[6]
